failures.problem: Methods > Chromatin immunoprecipitation (ChIP-seq) and bioinformatics analysis states 'Only regions with FDR values below the 0.05 threshold were considered differentially bound between two samples' in the same paragraph as the glmQLFit fit; this is a stated FDR cutoff for the edgeR QL test and should have been extracted rather than marked not reported (the article's own _applies=no note explains the QL pipeline is on ChIP-seq peaks rather than bulk RNA-seq, but the value is still literally present in the matched Methods text, as it was for comparable applies=no articles in this sample, e.g. PMC9825163 and PMC13558064, where present-but-off-target values were correctly extracted).
Same Methods paragraph states 'Only peaks with a log2-fold change >2 were retained for further analyses,' a stated post hoc fold-change filter that was not extracted.

Methods > Differential enrichment analysis states 'Sample normalization was performed with normFactors function using the trimmed mean of M-values (TMM) method,' in the same sentence group as the glmQLFit fit; this stated value was not extracted.
Same Methods paragraph states 'Statistical significance was determined on the basis of false discovery rates (FDR; <0.05)'; this stated cutoff was not extracted.
